# Reading Kingdom Blog

> A comprehensive resource for reading instruction, literacy development, and parenting guidance that combines evidence-based research with practical strategies for teaching children to read.

The Reading Kingdom Blog covers reading education, phonics instruction, child development, and parenting advice with a focus on literacy programs and learning strategies. The site features research-backed articles, teaching tips for diverse learners including those with dyslexia and autism, and educational insights from experts and educators.

## Key Topics

- Reading instruction
- Phonics instruction
- Literacy education
- Parenting tips
- Child development
- Dyslexia support
- Autism spectrum
- Educational research
- Reading programs
- K-3 reading
- Language learning
- Creativity development
- Writing systems
- Special needs education
- Student motivation

## Reading Instruction & Literacy

- [Tips for Teaching Dyslexic Kids to Read](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/tips-for-teaching-dyslexic-kids-to-read): Teaching strategies and phonics alternatives for children with dyslexia
- [Good Books to Inspire your Kids to Read](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/inspiring-children-to-read): Book recommendations and tips for inspiring children to develop independent reading habits
- [Reading boosts intelligence](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/reading-boosts-intelligence): Research from University of Edinburgh and King's College on reading's cognitive benefits
- [Hangul: when a country decides to change its writing system](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/hangul-when-a-country-decides-to-change-its-writing-system): History of Hangul writing system reform under Sejong the Great in Korea
- [Dinosaur Hunters by Kate McMullan](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/dinosaur-hunters-by-kate-mcmullan): Book review of Dinosaur Hunters for 4th grade reading level students

## Special Needs & Neurodevelopment

- [Ask Reading Kingdom - Reading Kingdom Blog](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/do-children-with-autism-lead-normal-lives): Q&A on autism outcomes and independent living with examples from Temple Grandin
- [When Things Turn Hard, Things Turn Stupid - Reading Kingdom Blog](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/when-things-are-hard-things-turns-stupid): Student motivation and learning struggle insights using Reading Kingdom program

## Parenting & Child Development

- [5 ways to inspire creativity in kids](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/5-ways-to-inspire-creativity-in-kids): Tips for inspiring child creativity through Reading Kingdom program and activities
- [Appropriate Chores for Kids](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/appropriate-chores-for-kids): Age-appropriate chore guide for teaching kids responsibility and household tasks
- [Daycare Confessions - Reading Kingdom Blog](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/daycare-confessions): Parenting perspective on daycare benefits for child development and social skills
- [Teaching Kids to Make a Difference in the world](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/teaching-kids-to-make-a-difference-in-the-world): Parenting advice on teaching empathy and global awareness to children
- [When Words Are Not the Way to Go - Reading Kingdom Blog](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/when-words-are-not-the-way-to-go): Parenting guidance on non-verbal communication and behavioral management

## Education & Schools

- [States with the Best & Worst School Systems (2026) - Reading Kingdom Blog](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/best-worst-states-to-raise-a-family-2026-2): Comparison of state school systems and education quality rankings for families
- [How One Arizona District Turned School Cafeterias Into Scratch Kitchens - Reading Kingdom Blog](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/how-one-arizona-district-turned-school-cafeterias-into-scratch-kitchens): Osborn school district Arizona innovation in school nutrition and cafeteria programs

## Wellness & Student Wellbeing

- [Study: Bingeing Tik Tok reels may be hazardous to your well-being. - Reading Kingdom Blog](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/study-bingeing-tik-tok-reels-may-be-hazardous-to-your-well-being): Research on TikTok and short-form video effects on mental health and wellbeing
- [Keep cool with Shade, a Breeze, and Water - Reading Kingdom Blog](https://blog.readingkingdom.com/keep-cool-with-shade-a-breeze-and-water): Summer activities and outdoor play tips for families with heat safety guidance
